title: Radio Astronomy
description: Cold hydrogen, invisible to any telescope, glows at 21 centimetres; dead stars spinning hundreds of times a second pulse in radio. A dish and a cold receiver hear them through cloud and daylight. Unlocks the Radio Telescope and the Cryogenic Receiver.

puzzle.goal: A cloud of hydrogen emits a line at frequency ν _ 0. Moving away from us at speed v, it is received at a lower frequency ν. For speeds far below light's, write v.
puzzle.name: Radial velocity from the line shift
puzzle.ask: Find v in km/s for the 21 cm line, A = 1420.406 MHz, received at B = 1420.000 MHz (c = 299792 km/s).
puzzle.method: Each successive wave crest is emitted v/c of a wavelength further away, so the received frequency drops by the fraction v/c.
